verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-intelligence API platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The SDK, CLI, llms.txt, OpenAPI spec and 'agent processor' endpoint are adjacent building blocks or different features, not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
